title: Database Relations and Joins
description: Create related tables with foreign keys, insert related data, and query with JOINs to combine users with their posts.

steps.title: Create related tables
steps.description: On startup, create a users table and a posts table with a foreign key referencing users.id. Enable foreign key constraints in SQLite.
hints: posts table: id, title, body, user_id with REFERENCES users(id)

codeTemplate.python:
from fastapi import FastAPI
import sqlite3
import os

app = FastAPI()
port = int(os.getenv('PORT', 3000))

db = sqlite3.connect(':memory:', check_same_thread=False)
db.executescript('PRAGMA foreign_keys = ON')
db.executescript('''
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    name TEXT NOT NULL,
    email TEXT NOT NULL
  )
''')
db.executescript('''
  CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS posts (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    title TEXT NOT NULL,
    body TEXT,
    user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id)
  )
''')

@app.get('/health')
def health():
    return {'status': 'ok'}

steps.title: Create users and posts
steps.description: Implement POST /users to create a user (return 201 with user data) and POST /posts to create a post linked to a user (return 201 with post data).
hints: Validate that user_id references an existing user

steps.title: Get user posts with JOIN
steps.description: Implement GET /users/:id/posts that returns all posts belonging to a specific user, using a SQL JOIN to include the author's name in each post.
hints: Use SELECT posts.*, users.name as author FROM posts JOIN users
Parameterize the user_id in the WHERE clause
Return the array of posts with author field

steps.title: Posts with author endpoint
steps.description: Implement GET /posts-with-author that returns all posts, each including the author's name using a JOIN. Response should be an array of objects with post fields plus 'author'.
hints: SELECT posts.*, users.name as author FROM posts JOIN users
No WHERE clause needed — get all posts
Each object should contain title, body, and author fields
